plan.notes: Source: official Cal Poly Humboldt 2025-2026 Catalog, 'Liberal Studies, Elementary Education Concentration, B.A. MAP' (Major Academic Plan). https://catalog.humboldt.edu/preview_program.php?catoid=14&poid=8504 MAPs are suggested 4-year pathways ('guide - not a rule'); GE, American Institutions, DCG, and Elective-or-Minor slots are chosen by the student with an advisor. total_credits (120) is the exact sum of the published MAP slots (15+14+15+16+15+15+15+15). Per-slot prerequisites are not published on MAP pages, so prereq arrays are intentionally empty.
